reason: I already take magnesium at night at home out of a bottle, so a sachet to carry around solves a problem I don't have. The lab report is nice, but I'd just keep using what's in my cabinet.
objection: I take it at night at home, I don't need it to go. Why pay $30 a month for a travel format when a bottle does the same thing for less?
would_change_my_mind: If my doctor's blood test showed I'm actually low and I needed a better quality magnesium than what I have now, or if a creator I trust showed the lab report next to my current brand and it came out clearly better.
